topics: A-core: Harness-level recursive self-improvement — an LLM agent system that modifies its own non-weight components (prompts, skills, tools, workflow, memory/playbook, agent code) from its own execution feedback and keeps/rejects changes via an evaluation loop. Papers that update model weights are NOT this topic.

B-component: A technique directly usable inside such a loop without weight updates — reflective/evolutionary prompt or program optimization, skill or playbook induction from trajectories, agentic workflow search, LLM tool creation, or evaluation/leakage methodology for self-improving agents.
